origins: arXiv:2601.17532 Information Gain Pruning for RAG (context pruning, 2026-01-27)
reason: Two distinct arXiv preprints with different identifiers, titles, authgroup-independent methods (boundary-aware reranking/evidence selection vs information-gain context pruning), different benchmarks and metrics (10.3% end-to-end gain vs +12-20% F1 with 76-79% token reduction), and different submission dates. The shared arxiv.org host does not collapse them; they report separate results from separate papers, so they are independent origins.
